fields.name: Spin Armor
fields.description: Your proficiency with Spin grants you 2 Spin armor charges that are regained during downtime.

fields.name: Golden Arc
fields.description: Your Spin projectiles return to you. On a 6, it may hit a second target. With two 6's, +1 effect or +1d to the follow-up strike.

fields.name: Vibrational Scan
fields.description: Use a spinning object to perform a Study or Survey roll up to 25m (80ft). +1 effect when detecting structures, weak points, or lifeforms.

fields.name: Kinetic Tether
fields.description: Spin threads can connect two objects. Once per score, create a tether that allows movement, redirection, or restraint. +1d when using it for repositioning or rescue.

fields.name: Throw Voice
fields.description: Use your spin tool to throw your voice up to 60ft. Push yourself to extend the range.

fields.name: Centripetal Force
fields.description: While moving, you gain a Spin armor charge. You must be in motion when you declare this. Use this armor to push yourself. If you lose momentum, it goes away.

fields.name: Detour
fields.description: Redirect an incoming AoE attack to a nearby area. Roll Finesse or Tinker; on a 6, full redirection with no residual consequence.

fields.name: Tendon Manipulation
fields.description: Before making an attack with a spin tool, name an opponent's limb. On a full success, you control that enemy's limb and make 1 action for them as long as the spin weapon is embedded in that limb (drop weapon, attack themselves, trip, etc). Enemies can attempt to resist.

fields.name: Stagnant Space
fields.description: You may use a spin tool to suspend an opponent up to 10ft midair.

fields.name: Miracle Shot
fields.description: On a partial success, curve your spin tool around 3/4 cover. Grants +1 position. On a crit, hit through supernatural barriers.

fields.name: Remote Connection
fields.description: You are able to remotely control/pilot your mount or vehicle without line of sight or vocal commands.

fields.name: Privileged Pilot
fields.description: Your mount gains an armor charge while moving. Losing momentum loses your armor charge.

fields.name: Kinetic Knockdown
fields.description: Spin-imbued Skirmish actions gain +1d while charging (aka speeding towards the opponent) on your mount. On a full success (6), the victim is forced back. On a crit, the victim is forced prone.

fields.name: Gravitic Leap
fields.description: While mounted/piloting, you may use a Spin armor charge to float or launch midair with Spin-warped gravity.

fields.name: Stirrup Surge
fields.description: Your mount is innately imbued with Spin energy, doubling their movement speed.

fields.name: Spiral Stampede
fields.description: In a group action with all allies converging on one or more opponents/goals, add +1d to each player's roll, enabling their actions with Spin.

fields.name: Overload Hit
fields.description: Take -1d to deal damage with increased potency (+1 effect).

fields.name: Line Cutter
fields.description: A straight-line throw hits up to 3 foes in your operational Range. Costs 1 stress if used mid-fight rather than in setup.

fields.name: Civil Engineer
fields.description: On a partial success, your spin tool can change the integrity of a nearby structure within 40ft. You can cause this structure to collapse and hinder opponents. On a full success, modify the integrity of the structure to turn it into a new structure (change and mold the form and function of walls, roads, objects/entities, etc.)

fields.name: Devastation Chain
fields.description: Taking out an enemy grants a free follow-up throw at -1d. On a crit, the follow up continues, again.

fields.name: Shotgun Scatter
fields.description: Use a Spin armor charge to split a projectile mid-air using a spin tool. Then, target a number of opponents within range of the original attack. The projectile cannot be reformed into its original form.

fields.name: Cosmetic Reconstruction
fields.description: You are able to use a spin tool to reconstruct the physical appearance of an ally or foe. You can make them look younger, older, or reconstruct their face for as long as your spin tool is embedded in them.

fields.name: Spin Suture
fields.description: You may use your spin tool from afar to aid an ally mid-combat (if an ally has level 3 harm, they may act as if you aided them).

fields.name: Precision Incision
fields.description: When healing with a Spin-charged tool (Tinker or Bizarre), heal +1 segment.

fields.name: Triage Sphere
fields.description: Deploy a floating orb. Allies within 20ft of the orb gain +1d to resistance rolls for one scene.

fields.name: Spinfield Stabilizer
fields.description: Create a field where allies may reduce incoming Harm by 1 level. Requires a fixed location; lasts until the location is compromised or the scene ends.

fields.name: Emergency Fusion
fields.description: Once per score, two PCs may act as one: combine clocks, action ratings, stress pool, and armor pool for 1 scene. Costs 2 stress per user.

fields.name: Dismantle Strike
fields.description: Hit a weapon or body part with Spin. On a partial success, the weapon/limb is unusable. On a full success, the weapon/limb is completely destroyed. An opponent must use armor to avoid the consequence.

fields.name: Spin Fakeout
fields.description: Create a visual or auditory decoy. +1d to Prowl or to spring traps. Once per scene, an enemy acts on false information — the GM determines how this plays out.

fields.name: Magnetic Pulse
fields.description: Push or pull a metal object within your operational Range. Break line of sight or create an opening. Costs 1 stress.

fields.name: Fracture Intent
fields.description: On a 6, the enemy misreads your intent. They target the wrong person or act at the wrong time.

fields.name: Jammer Spiral
fields.description: Once per score, nullify one relic, power, or tech device within F-rank Range (10ft) until its user pushes themselves to reactivate it. Costs 2 stress.

fields.name: Stand Stagger
fields.description: Hit a Stand user with Spin. Their Stand loses its next reaction or triggered effect.

fields.name: Spin Muzzle
fields.description: Suppress sound-based abilities or commands within F-rank Range (10ft) until the situation shifts or a target pushes themselves to break through.

fields.name: Cascading Spin
fields.description: Debuffs spread on contact. Pick two targets; enemies that physically interact with them inherit the effect, and so on. Costs 2 stress.
